name: Impenetrable Dartcap
description: Open with a javelin in each hand and both points toward the foe so the pair guards the whole front.

name: Launchruin
description: Throw with the left hand and the right in strict turn so that no gap shows between the shafts.

name: Fletchvortex
description: Step each foot in time with the opposite hand so the two shafts stay level through every move.

name: Hoarfrost Launch
description: Throw one shaft and echo it a heartbeat later along the same line with qi on the second.

name: Equipoise Lightshaft
description: Catch a thrown shaft on one javelin and send it back with the other in a mirrored stroke.

name: Launchmettle
description: Strike both points together on a guarding arm to numb it and silence its answer.

name: Devastating Loft
description: Loose both shafts from opposite sides of the body so they close on the foe from two angles.

name: Confluent Dart
description: Chain a thrust and a cast and a return catch so that the pair never leaves the fight.

name: Titanic Facet Dropdive
description: Throw both shafts so each strikes a different mark that the foe cannot guard at the same time.

name: Fletchrespite
description: Narrow the gaze to a hawk's and pick one small mark out of a crowded field.

name: Barbedinsight
description: Hold the arm drawn and perfectly still for a breath while the mark settles into the line.

name: Meteoric Dartpoint
description: Spring from a crouch across several paces so the thrower lands already in the act of throwing.

name: Fletchwrath
description: Spread both arms wide like wings and bring the throwing arm through in one long sweep.

name: Daybreak Tailweight
description: Let qi flow past the fingertips along the shaft so that the arm seems to reach a pace farther.

name: Iron Skewerflight
description: Throw from a height at a steep angle so that the point drops onto the mark with qi behind it.

name: Leadwrath
description: Make the shaft feather-light with qi for the first half of its flight and bring its weight back to land.

name: Facet Whistle
description: Cast with the full reach of the arm and a narrow thread of qi so the point pierces at long range.

name: Booming Dartcap
description: Gather qi for a long breath and loose a high volley of shafts that fall together from above.

name: Wrathful Tempered Launch
description: Throw so fast and from so high that the foe sees only the shadow before the point arrives.

name: Barbedscourge
description: Bring the arm through a smooth curve like the sides of a basin and release at its lowest point.

name: Aegis Pointbalance
description: Stand as still as water in a basin so that a blow finds no motion to follow.

name: Dazzling Whistle
description: Slide the feet along an imagined rim to circle a foe without crossing the legs.

name: Vital Throwloop
description: Draw qi down into the belly until it pools there and let it rise into the arm on release.

name: Rumble Skewerflight
description: Cast so that a ripple of qi spreads around the point and unsettles the foe's footing as it lands.

name: Dartruin
description: Skip the shaft along the ground like a flat stone on water to rise again beyond a low guard.

name: Downpour Dropdive
description: Loose all the pooled qi at once so that it spills out around the point in a flood on landing.

name: Chime Thinheft
description: Meet an attack with the flat of the shaft and turn its force back in a cast at the attacker.

name: Glint Launch
description: Gather all the pooled qi in the arm for a long breath and loose it in one falling cascade through the point.

name: Lightning Fletch
description: Set the toes at the very edge of a bank so no pace of range is lost to the ground.

name: Loftwrath
description: Throw across open water at a mark on the far bank with the arm fully extended.

name: Torrent Dartpoint
description: Wade a ford in short low steps with the shaft held clear of the surface.

name: Fletchspine
description: Drop into a reed bed with the shaft laid along the back so the thrower cannot be seen.

name: Remnant Lightshaft
description: Read a far bank's marks through haze and ripple and judge where the foe will stand.

name: Hoarfrost Dropdive
description: Carry the shaft on a thread of qi so that its flight spans the full width of a river.

name: Unerring Pointbalance
description: Turn the wrist at release to cancel the sideways pull of a current on a thrown cord.

name: Plumehavoc
description: Throw once toward the far bank and again toward the near so a crossing foe is struck from both sides.

name: Murk Dartcap
description: Meet a shaft in midstream with another cast so the two fall into the water together.

name: Dartscourge
description: Throw in a steady rolling run across the water until the far bank is covered with shafts.

name: Nova Whistle
description: Make one great cast that pins a crossing foe in midstream and stops the whole crossing.

name: Wrathful Dart
description: Release two shafts on the same breath with one thrown a hand's breadth behind the other.

name: Loftruin
description: Throw the off-hand shaft first and let the strong hand follow into the line it has cleared.

name: Plumeinsight
description: Count the beats between two releases until the gap between the shafts is always the same.

name: Launchblink
description: Run with both javelins carried side by side and cast them without a break in the stride.

name: Fletchinsight
description: Choose two shafts of the same weight and balance so that both fly alike.

name: Intent Leadknob
description: Tie a thread of qi between the two shafts so that each feels the other in flight.

name: Blaze Dropdive
description: Throw a swift leading shaft and a slower follower so that the second lands where the first draws the eye.

name: Launchhavoc
description: Send the pair on diverging paths that bend back to the same mark at the last moment.

name: Gust Dartpoint
description: Wheel both unthrown javelins in front of the body to sweep away a swarm of small missiles.

name: Rampaging Whistle
description: Throw the pair wide of the foe on either side and bend them inward to close like a pincer.

name: Rumble Throwloop
description: Cross the two flights in front of a raised guard so that it opens to follow one and meets the other.

name: Vengeful Rumble Launch
description: Send two shafts so close behind each other that the second enters the wound that the first has made.

name: Torrential Lightshaft
description: Climb a bank or a roof with the shaft tied across the back to gain height before the throw.

name: Hoarfrost Dartcap
description: Hold the shaft slanted over the head to turn aside what falls from above.

name: Waning Pointbalance
description: Lean over a ledge and sight down the shaft to a mark far below.

name: Launchscourge
description: Throw straight up at a falling foe with qi on the shaft so it climbs to meet them.

name: Tempered Skewerflight
description: Pin a foe's cloak or sleeve in the air so that the fall spoils their aim.

name: Equipoise Leadknob
description: Spring a pulse of qi up through the legs and arms to leap and meet a stoop in the air.

name: Gnashing Dart
description: Hurl the shaft straight up through a storm of falling blows to strike the one who threw them.

name: Unbowed Tailweight
description: Wheel the shaft overhead as a diving foe arrives and break the dive aside with the flat.

name: Nova Loft
description: Time the throw to meet a stooping foe at the top of the fall and tear them out of the dive.

name: Barbedvigil
description: Take a bearing on a far mark with the lead shoulder and hold it in mind.

name: Flintlike Lightshaft
description: Speak the oath under the breath and settle into the draw stance that must not be broken.

name: Verity Thinheft
description: Feel the wind turn on the cheek and shift the aim a hair to meet it.

name: Leadflash
description: Close the last distance with two long strides that never break the line of the bearing.

name: Darthavoc
description: Lock qi along the bearing and throw so that the shaft will not leave it for any gust.

name: Grievous Whistle
description: Hold the oath through the release so the shaft flies as straight as the sworn word.

name: Ferocious Dropdive
description: Speak the closing word of the oath on the instant of release and let qi go with it.

name: Merciless Launch
description: Hold the draw and the bearing for many breaths and release only when the wind goes still.

name: Unconquered Dartpoint
description: Plant the butt and turn the point to meet a rush so the oath-bearer gives no ground.

name: Iron Launch
description: Release the shaft on the bearing sworn and let it fly true to the mark through any wind.

name: Granite Throwloop
description: Grip the bare plateau stone with the toes and brace the shaft across the body.

name: Gust Dartcap
description: Lean into the gale and throw low under its push so the shaft does not lift.

name: Plumeglare
description: Take quick short steps across broken stone without losing the line of the throw.

name: Might Leadknob
description: Swing the throwing arm in wide circles to gather the gale's push into the qi of the arm.

name: Hoarfrost Whistle
description: Throw the shaft at a cliff face and catch it on the rebound to throw it again.

name: Dartwrath
description: Wait for a rising gust and cast overhand so that it lifts the shaft over a guard.

name: Glint Dropdive
description: Charge the shaft with the gale's push and drive it straight through a shield and armour.

name: Slag Whistle
description: Gather the gale for a long draw and loose a spreading volley across the whole width of the front.

name: Nova Skewerflight
description: Hold every gathered gust in the arm and release them through one shaft that falls like a spear from the sky.

name: Chime Fletch
description: Stand with the wind at the back and feel how much it will add to the throw.

name: Facet Launch
description: Release overhand on the crest of a gust so the shaft leaves with the wind's strength behind it.

name: Leadinsight
description: Count the gaps between gusts and fix the beat on which the throw will go.

name: Thorn Lightshaft
description: Drop to the lee side of a rock and hold the shaft low until the foe shows himself.

name: Silt Dartcap
description: Run with the wind so that its push lengthens each stride toward the throwing line.

name: Fletchhavoc
description: Wrap the shaft in qi so that the wind carries it as a sail carries a boat.

name: Rampaging Dart
description: Throw at a mark behind a hill trusting the bearing and the wind to bring the shaft home.

name: Plumerespite
description: Feel the shaft in flight through the qi on it and nudge it back to the line.

name: Rumble Loft
description: Cast on a long rising arc and let the wind swell beneath the shaft all the way down.

name: Mayhem Dropdive
description: Throw shaft after shaft on one wind so that they fall like hail upon a distant ridge.

name: Tempered Whistle
description: Swear the wind to the shaft and cast it to a foe on the horizon who never saw the thrower.

name: Plumevigil
description: Turn the lead shoulder until it points down the bearing and the throwing arm lies behind it.

name: Leadscourge
description: Speak the first word of the oath as the arm draws and the last as it lets go.

name: Might Dartpoint
description: Walk forward on the bearing without letting the shoulder drift from the line.

name: Daybreak Thinheft
description: Bind the oath into the shaft with qi so that it carries the thrower's whole intent.

name: Eviscerating Dart
description: Judge where the first throw fell and correct the bearing for the second in a single breath.

name: Ponderous Throwloop
description: Throw into the path of a pursuer so that the shaft stands upright and bars the way.

name: Shattering Launch
description: Throw with the bearing held and the oath spoken so every part of the body moves as one.

name: Sanguine Leadknob
description: Answer a foe who has broken a sworn truce with a short hard thrust from the shaft.

name: Glint Dartpoint
description: Cast the shaft on a bearing held through a long draw so that it cannot miss the mark it was sworn to.

name: Chime Tailweight
description: Read the edge of an oncoming storm to learn where its cover will fall.

name: Barbedglimmer
description: Run in a crouch behind a curtain of rain so that the foe sees only a passing shape.

name: Blaze Skewerflight
description: Throw in the quiet gap between two gusts before the next one arrives.

name: Leadrespite
description: Wrap the grip in a dry cord so that rain cannot spoil the hold on the shaft.

name: Loftscourge
description: Throw on the crack of thunder when the foe's ears are filled and his guard is slow.

name: Barbednerve
description: Spread qi across the skin until the cold of the rain and the sting of the wind pass over harmless.

name: Torrent Whistle
description: Step into the shadow of a racing cloud and be gone from the foe's sight for a breath.

name: Punishing Dart
description: Throw flat along the squall so that its push doubles the speed of the shaft.

name: Murk Lightshaft
description: Whirl the shaft in time with a gust to catch and fling away an incoming spear.

name: Overlapping Launch
description: Throw and fade into the rain and appear from another side to throw again without pause.

name: Granite Loft
description: Gather the storm's force in the arm and loose a shower of shafts like hail on one stretch of ground.

name: Rumble Dartpoint
description: Throw in the flash of lightning so that the point strikes before the foe's eyes have cleared.

name: Impervious Pointbalance
description: Stand on bare ground with nothing behind and hold the shaft angled out at the foe.

name: Verity Leadknob
description: Pause before each throw and choose its target as if it were the last shaft.

name: Lightning Dart
description: Run straight at the foe across open ground with the shaft cocked behind the ear.

name: Gust Throwloop
description: Test the edge of the plateau with the heel before stepping and throwing from it.

name: Remnant Dartpoint
description: Hold a bearing across wide empty ground by qi sense when no landmark stands.

name: Energizing Thinheft
description: Draw all the arm's qi into the one remaining shaft before the final throw.

name: Unsparing Whistle
description: Throw backward over the shoulder at a close pursuer without breaking stride.

name: Blaze Loft
description: Brace both feet on the ground and throw with the whole body so there is nothing left to give.

name: Adamantine Tailweight
description: Plant the shaft and meet a mounted charge on the open plateau with the point angled at the chest.

name: Iron Dropdive
description: Spend everything in the arm on one last throw across the open ground and trust it to strike.
